name: android-foundation
description: Android Foundation — the centerpiece Android stack provider (Kotlin + Gradle) for the Agentic SDLC marketplace. Registers the android profile via stack.md (aspect: android, priority 300); provides the full specialized agent roster plus convention skills for Jetpack Compose UI, architecture, data and Navigation-Compose. Carries the pinned house rules (Coil3, Kermit, KSP, @Serializable routes, DataStore, Play Billing); detect-don't-impose libraries (Retrofit, Room, Dagger/Hilt) attach as additive framework plugins. Builds are CI-deferred; in-pipeline verification is detekt + unit tests + Kotlin compile-check.
